cases.claim: Based on the given passages, we can say that the primary difference between single cream and double cream in Britain is the butterfat content
cases.reason: Retain the explicit comparison of fat content; this diagnoses evidence presence without establishing the word primary independently.

alternatives.quote: Double cream has a higher fat content than single.

In Britain, single cream refers to a milk product that has between 10 percent and 12 percent butterfat.This relatively low level of butterfat creates a thin liquid similar to the U.S. product called half and half. In contrast, double cream in Britain refers to a cream product containing 48 percent butterfat.

cases.claim: Single cream also has a higher binding ability due to its higher fat content
cases.reason: Both the comparison direction and the causal binding sentence are required to interpret it as double cream.

alternatives.quote: Double cream has a higher fat content than single.
Because of the higher fat content it will bind with the flour ion the pasta to produce a thicker sauce.
